narrator.voice_description: A deep, slow, epic movie-trailer narrator, a man with a resonant low bass voice, gravelly and commanding, measured dramatic pacing, clean studio recording.
narrator.text: Every child in the clan faced the beast. Every child was rejected. For three hundred years the ancient wolf bowed to no one, and the mountain waited in silence.

asha.voice_description: A woman in her forties with a low, husky, commanding voice, a hardened warrior chieftain, urgent and protective, Nordic-inflected English accent, clean studio recording.
asha.text: Not you, child. It will tear you apart. Stay behind me. Vorr hasn't bowed in three hundred years, and it will not bow today.

sigrun.voice_description: A young woman of nineteen with a strong, clear, proud voice, a fierce shieldmaiden, bold and confident with a hint of arrogance, slight Nordic accent, clean studio recording.
sigrun.text: Kneel, old wolf. Your rider is here. I have trained for this every day of my life, and today the whole clan will watch you bow to me.

grima.voice_description: A very old woman in her eighties with a thin, cracked, rasping voice, a frightened seer whispering a terrible secret, slow and trembling, slight Nordic accent, clean studio recording.
grima.text: That scar. He got it the night we found her. I was there. I saw the sky burn, and I have kept silent for four long winters.
